text: Course Overview: This major is a first-level discipline, with two secondary disciplines: Communication and Information System, and Signal and Information Processing. It covers numerous high-tech fields such as wireless communication, multimedia and image processing, electromagnetic fields and microwaves, satellite mobile video, etc., and is dedicated to solving the core issues of information transmission and processing in modern society.Training Objectives: To cultivate scientific research and engineering professionals in the field of information and communication engineering and university teachers. Students are required to have a solid theoretical foundation in communication theory and systems, information transmission and processing technologies, etc., possess professional knowledge and skills in signal detection and estimation, signal analysis and processing, etc., and have the ability to conduct research in this discipline area.Main Courses: Main disciplines include Communication Engineering, Electronic Technology, and Computer Science and Technology. Main courses include Circuit Analysis, Communication Electronic Circuits, Pulse Digital Circuits, Digital Signal Processing, Signals and Linear Systems, Microcomputer Principles and Applications, Electromagnetic Field Theory, Microwave Technology and Antennas, Communication System Principles, Information Theory and Coding, Program-controlled Switching Technology, Mobile Communication Technology, Computer Network Communication, Optical Fiber Communication Technology, etc.Research Directions: The research areas of this major at Xi'an Jiaotong University cover broadband wireless communication, communication network theory and engineering, intelligent communication and networks, multi-antenna transmission theory, medical image coding and transmission, video image processing, etc. The research directions of Qingdao University of Technology include Integrated Circuit Design and IP Protection, Multimedia Technology, Communication Network and Implementation, Complex Networks, Electronic Systems and Electromagnetic Compatibility, etc.
